from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,io,json,shutil,sqlite3,subprocess,sys
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'outputs/hive-prototype';work=root/'work/replication-coverage'
sys.path.insert(0,str(out));import replication as r;import knowledge;import hive
config=json.loads((root/'work/replication/client.json').read_text());primary=Path(config['database'])
pop=json.loads((work/'population.json').read_text())
assert len(pop['queries'])==3 and all(q['result']['status']==q['expected_status'] for q in pop['queries'])
record={'started_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'population':pop,'remote_fault_tests':[],'emergency_backup_used':False}
def save():(work/'drill.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
def links(db):
 with r.database(db) as conn:
  rows=[dict(zip(r.COLS,row)) for row in conn.execute('SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY sequence')]
 byid={row['id']:row for row in rows};proof=[]
 def payload(eid):return json.loads(byid[eid]['payload'])
 def source_for(chunk_id):
  sid,offset=chunk_id.rsplit(':',1);source=payload(sid)
  assert byid[sid]['kind']=='source_ingested'
  assert hashlib.sha256(source['text'].encode()).hexdigest()==source['sha256']
  chunk=next(c for c in knowledge.chunks({'id':sid,**source}) if c['chunk_id']==chunk_id)
  return sid,source,chunk
 for q in pop['queries']:
  task=q['result']['task_id'];events=[e for e in rows if e['run_id']==task]
  queries=[e for e in events if e['kind']=='knowledge_query'];assert len(queries)==1
  query=queries[0];result=json.loads(query['payload']);assert result==q['result']
  item={'task_id':task,'query_event_id':query['id'],'status':result['status'],'source_links':[]}
  if result['status']=='supported_answer':
   citation=result['citation'];sid,source,chunk=source_for(citation['chunk_id'])
   assert citation['source_id']==sid and citation['sha256']==source['sha256']
   assert result['quote'] in chunk['text'] and knowledge.anchored(result['answer'],result['quote'])
   supports=[e for e in events if e['kind']=='model_call' and e['cookie']=='cookie-support']
   checks=[e for e in events if e['kind']=='support_check'];assert len(supports)==len(checks)==1
   support=payload(supports[0]['id']);check=payload(checks[0]['id'])
   assert check and all(value is True for value in check.values())
   assert support['context']=={'question':q['question'],'quote':result['quote']}
   assert support['context_sha256']==hive.digest(support['context'])
   item.update(answer=result['answer'],quote=result['quote'],support_event_id=supports[0]['id'],support_check_id=checks[0]['id'],support_link_type='same run_id; no direct support-event foreign key on the supported query')
   item['source_links'].append({'source_id':sid,'chunk_id':citation['chunk_id'],'sha256':source['sha256']})
  else:
   finding=payload(result['finding_id']);assert finding['finding']=='not_found_in_source'
   confirm=payload(finding['confirmation_id']);check=payload(finding['absence_check_id'])
   assert byid[finding['confirmation_id']]['run_id']==task
   assert byid[finding['confirmation_id']]['cookie']=='cookie-support'
   assert confirm['purpose']=='independent_answer_search' and confirm['answer']['outcome']=='not_found_in_source' and confirm['answer']['answer']==''
   assert check['confirmation_id']==finding['confirmation_id'] and all(v is True for v in check['checks'].values())
   assert confirm['context']['question']==q['question'] and set(confirm['context'])=={'question','quote'}
   texts=[]
   for chunk_id in finding['searched_chunk_ids']:
    sid,source,chunk=source_for(chunk_id);texts.append(chunk['text'])
    item['source_links'].append({'source_id':sid,'chunk_id':chunk_id,'sha256':source['sha256']})
   assert '\n\n'.join(texts)==confirm['context']['quote']
   assert confirm['context_sha256']==hive.digest(confirm['context'])
   item.update(finding_id=result['finding_id'],confirmation_id=finding['confirmation_id'],absence_check_id=finding['absence_check_id'],support_link_type='explicit confirmation_id and absence_check_id')
  source_ids={s['source_id'] for s in item['source_links']}
  item['linked_event_sha256']={e['id']:hashlib.sha256(r.canonical(e)).hexdigest() for e in rows if e['run_id']==task or e['id'] in source_ids}
  proof.append(item)
 return proof
package=work/'accepted-snapshot';expected=r.snapshot(primary,package,config['database_id']);record['manifest']=expected
record['links_before']=links(package/'knowledge.sqlite3');save()
record['push']=r.transfer(config,'push',package);assert record['push']['manifest']==expected
baseline=r.transfer(config,'status');record['replica_before_faults']=baseline;save()
for name in ['reordering','modified_event','deleted_event','rollback']:
 if name=='rollback':
  attack=root/'work/replication/initial-snapshot'
 else:
  attack=work/name;attack.mkdir();shutil.copyfile(package/'knowledge.sqlite3',attack/'knowledge.sqlite3')
  with sqlite3.connect(attack/'knowledge.sqlite3') as conn:
   if name=='deleted_event':
    trigger=conn.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='no_delete'").fetchone()[0]
    conn.execute('DROP TRIGGER no_delete');conn.execute('DELETE FROM events WHERE sequence=?',(expected['event_count'],));conn.execute("UPDATE sqlite_sequence SET seq=? WHERE name='events'",(expected['event_count']-1,));conn.execute(trigger)
   else:
    trigger=conn.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='no_update'").fetchone()[0];conn.execute('DROP TRIGGER no_update')
    if name=='modified_event':conn.execute("UPDATE events SET cookie='tampered-copy-only' WHERE sequence=1")
    else:
     temporary=expected['event_count']+1
     conn.execute('UPDATE events SET sequence=? WHERE sequence=1',(temporary,));conn.execute('UPDATE events SET sequence=1 WHERE sequence=2');conn.execute('UPDATE events SET sequence=2 WHERE sequence=?',(temporary,))
    conn.execute(trigger)
  (attack/'manifest.json').write_bytes(r.canonical(r.manifest_for(attack/'knowledge.sqlite3',config['database_id'])))
 manifest=r.validate(attack,config['database_id'])
 wire=io.BytesIO();r.send(attack,wire)
 result=subprocess.run(r.ssh_command(config,'push'),input=wire.getvalue(),capture_output=True,timeout=30)
 after=r.transfer(config,'status')
 row={'test':name,'valid_recomputed_manifest':manifest,'exit':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout.decode(),'stderr':result.stderr.decode(),'accepted_state_unchanged':after==baseline}
 record['remote_fault_tests'].append(row);save()
 assert result.returncode==1 and 'History rewrite, deletion, or rollback' in row['stderr'] and row['accepted_state_unchanged'],row
 print(name,'REJECTED; accepted state unchanged',flush=True)
record['valid_retry']=r.transfer(config,'push',package);assert record['valid_retry']['status']=='unchanged';save()
r.restore(config,work/'rehearsal.sqlite3',expected);assert links(work/'rehearsal.sqlite3')==record['links_before']
emergency=work/'emergency-before-deletion';backup=r.snapshot(primary,emergency,config['database_id']);assert backup==expected
paths=[Path(str(primary)+s) for s in ('','-wal','-shm','-journal') if Path(str(primary)+s).exists()]
probe=subprocess.run(['lsof','-Fpn','--',*[str(p) for p in paths]],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
assert probe.returncode==1 and not probe.stdout.strip() and not probe.stderr.strip(),(probe.returncode,probe.stdout,probe.stderr)
record['lsof']={'exit':probe.returncode,'stdout':probe.stdout,'stderr':probe.stderr};record['deleted_paths']=[];save()
for path in paths:path.unlink();record['deleted_paths'].append(str(path));save()
record['primary_absent_before_restore']=not primary.exists();assert record['primary_absent_before_restore'];save()
try:record['restored_manifest']=r.restore(config,primary,expected)
except Exception:
 if not primary.exists():shutil.copyfile(emergency/'knowledge.sqlite3',primary);record['emergency_backup_used']=True;save()
 raise
record['links_after']=links(primary);record['all_links_identical']=record['links_before']==record['links_after']
record['byte_identical']=r.sha(primary)==expected['sha256'];record['history_identical']=r.inspect(primary)==r.inspect(emergency/'knowledge.sqlite3')
assert record['all_links_identical'] and record['byte_identical'] and record['history_identical']
tests=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','-q'],cwd=out,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
record['unit_tests']={'exit':tests.returncode,'stdout':tests.stdout,'stderr':tests.stderr};save();assert tests.returncode==0
record['replica_after']=r.transfer(config,'status');assert record['replica_after']==baseline
prior=json.loads((work/'prior-hashes.json').read_text());assert all(hashlib.sha256((out/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest for name,digest in prior.items())
record['prior_record_hashes_unchanged']=prior;record['finished_utc']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat();record['status']='passed';save()
print('Recovery, evidence links, all 81 tests: PASSED',flush=True)
